title: Provenance-Audited Evaluation of Morphology-Based Pseudo-Label Filtering in CT Vertebra Segmentation: A Split-Controlled Case Study
description: Reproducibility package for a split-controlled, subject-equal evaluation of morphology-based pseudo-label filtering in CT vertebra segmentation. The release contains path-free inputs, statistical scripts and outputs, provenance manifests, calibration source data, and figure source data; it does not redistribute CT volumes, annotations, checkpoints, or prediction masks.
